bright-data.free_tier: Free tier: 5,000 requests/month via the MCP server (renews on the 1st, no card required); other products pay-as-you-go

browserbase-stagehand.free_tier: Free tier: 1 browser hour/month, 3 concurrent browsers, 15 min/session, no card required
browserbase-stagehand.notes: Billed by browser-hours/compute time; Stagehand SDK itself is open source but needs a browser backend such as Browserbase. The MCP GitHub repo was archived in July 2026; use the hosted endpoint.

oxylabs.free_tier: Trial: Web Scraper API free trial with up to 2,000 results one-time, no card required
oxylabs.notes: Enterprise-oriented pricing overall, but self-serve API-user creation and free trial are available via the dashboard. Official MCP is hosted at mcp.oxylabs.io; its GitHub repo was archived on 2026-09-16.

scrapegraphai-api.free_tier: Free: 500 API credits per month, no card required

scraperapi.free_tier: Free: free plan with 1,000 API credits per month (max 5 concurrent connections); new accounts start with a 7-day trial of 5,000 one-time credits, no card required
scraperapi.notes: Widely used alternative to ScrapingBee/Zyte; official hosted MCP server at mcp.scraperapi.com/mcp.

scrapingbee.notes: Postman collection provided in place of a published OpenAPI spec. Hosted MCP takes the API key as an api_key query parameter on the server URL.

steel.free_tier: Trial: Launch plan is $0 + usage with $30 one-time usage credits valid 90 days (10 concurrent sessions, 60 requests/min); no Hobby plan
steel.notes: Open-source self-hostable browser engine (steel-browser) also available; official MCP server at steel-dev/steel-mcp-server.

autodesk-platform-services-aps.free_tier: Free tier: limited usage of rated APIs (Automation, Model Derivative, Flow Graph Engine, Reality Capture) per month, renews monthly; Pay as You Go beyond that needs a card or PayPal
autodesk-platform-services-aps.notes: Successor to Autodesk Forge; requires an Autodesk account and app registration in the APS console. Autodesk publishes reference MCP servers (Node.js, Python, .NET) to run yourself; no hosted endpoint.

bentley-itwin-platform-apis.free_tier: Free tier: Community plan with 100 credits/month, 10 GB cloud data, 100 GB reality data; non-commercial, non-production use only; no expiry

esri-arcgis-location-platform.notes: Free sign-up; usage beyond free monthly credits is billed per service call. MCP support for location services (geocoding, routing, elevation, static maps) is in beta.

onshape-rest-api.auth_hint: API key pair (access/secret) via Basic auth (base64 access:secret) or optional HMAC request signature; OAuth2 Bearer token for published apps
onshape-rest-api.notes: Free-tier API access is limited to public documents; private/commercial use needs a paid Onshape subscription. FeatureScript MCP server is in early access via Onshape Labs (App Store subscription).

procore-api.notes: Requires joining the Procore Developer Program and OAuth app approval for production scopes; sandbox is free. Official AI Edge MCP (US02: us02.procore.com) authenticates with a Datagrid API key.

rhino-compute-mcneel.free_tier: Paid only: self-hosted, requires a Rhino license; core-hour billing at $0.10 per core per hour of Rhino uptime on Windows Server, no free allowance

amazon-selling-partner-api.notes: Self-authorized (private) apps for your own seller account are relatively quick to set up; public apps serving other sellers require Amazon's app-approval review. Official MCP uses Seller Central OAuth consent.

bigcommerce-api.notes: Official Storefront MCP (B2C/B2B, per-store URL from the control panel) covers catalog, cart and checkout only, not the admin API; docs.bigcommerce.com/_mcp/server is a docs-search MCP.

ebay-apis.notes: Production access requires an eBay developer account and app keys; rate limits scale with account compliance tier. Official MCP (npx @ebay/npm-public-api-mcp) runs locally, read-only (GET) in production.

etsy-open-api-v3.free_tier: Free: developer keystring at no cost; rate limits (QPS/QPD) are set per app and shown in the Developer Portal
etsy-open-api-v3.notes: Requires an approved Etsy developer app; OAuth2 user consent needed for shop-management scopes. Missing from candidate list despite being a major agent-callable marketplace API. Official Dev MCP covers the API spec only; it does not call the API.

shopify-admin-storefront-api.notes: REST Admin API is legacy; new public apps must use GraphQL Admin. Dev MCP (npx @shopify/dev-mcp) serves docs/schemas only; per-store Storefront MCP at https://{shop}.myshopify.com/api/mcp needs no auth (catalog, cart, policies).

woocommerce-rest-api.notes: Requires your own WordPress+WooCommerce installation; there is no shared multi-tenant cloud endpoint. Official MCP (developer preview) at /wp-json/mcp/mcp-adapter-default-server, auth via Application Passwords.
